original.statement: The Crossplane v2 upgrade guide lists "Configure managed resource activation policies" as step 3 of the upgrade approach.

decision.reason: The cited heading [ev-188e63ccea10] only names upgrade step 3. The section text for that step [ev-06a16cdbc869] explains it: Crossplane v2 automatically creates a default MRAP that activates all managed resources (`*`), and replacing it with a targeted MRAP is something operators "can optionally" do for better cluster resource efficiency. Because nothing fails or has to be converted when the step is skipped, it is not a mandatory operator step, so migration-required is wrong. The migration family only allows migration-required, so there is no correct assertion in that family to replace it with.
